alex: Heads-up — nightly job 12:30 UTC triggered a regression for long-context runs (>=64k tokens). Several pods hit OOM and a few more had 20-30s stalls during generation. Dumped profiler + allocator traces.

sara: Which model/config and what host? can you paste the minimal repro command?

alex: repro on redwood-v2-xl-long (paged-attn enabled). Batch=2, seq=65536, request tokens ~50k, kv_cache max_blocks=512, block_size=64. Host: g4dnx-16 (A100-ish). Repro command:

```
./serve --model redwood-v2-xl-long --batch 2 --max-seq 65536 --paged-attn true --block-size 64 --kv-max-blocks 512
```

Attached profiler snippet (top hot spots):

```
[profile] attn_paged_generic_kernel  43.2%  (wall)
[profile] kernel_select: picked attn_paged_generic because workspace_required=1.2GB > workspace_limit=1.0GB
[alloc] blockmgr.compaction  18.7% CPU  scan=472ms per-cycle
[alloc] allocator.total_reserved  24.1GB  resident=22.9GB  fragmentation=8.6%
[error] OOM on allocate kv_block 131072 (requested 128KB * 1024)
```

miguel: Looks like kernel selection is falling back to the generic kernel because workspace_required exceeds the per-stream workspace cap. That generic kernel is noticeably slower and triggers more transient allocations, which then makes compaction run more often.

dave: Also seeing blockmgr compaction scanning lots of cold blocks; compaction cost scales with max_blocks. With block_size=64 tokens we end up with ~500 blocks for long contexts and compaction is O(n) scan -> big CPU + mem churn. Two quick levers: increase block_size to 128 tokens to reduce meta overhead, or tune compaction thresholds so it only compacts when free_blocks < X% for Y seconds.

alex: Reproducer logs showed compaction started right after kernel fallback (timing correlation). I also dumped the allocator freelist snapshot:

```
free_chunks: 38
free_total_bytes: 1.2GB
largest_free: 256MB
hot_buffers: 14  (pinned)
```

sara: For immediate mitigation we can:
- temporarily reduce batch size to 1 for long-context requests (low cost, avoids workspace crossing threshold)
- enable fallback-model-route (lower memory quantized variant) for requests > 32k tokens
- or increase workspace_limit to 1.5GB in the serving config on canary nodes to allow tensorcore kernel selection

miguel: Prefer trying workspace tuning + blockmgr policy change before changing customer-facing flows. Proposed quick patch to try on canary:
- runtime.workspaces.per_stream_limit = 1.5GB
- blockmgr.block_size = 128
- blockmgr.compaction_interval_secs = 120
- blockmgr.compaction_scan_fraction = 0.02  # avoid full scans
- allocator.buffer_coalesce = true  # reduce fragmentation

dave: Another thought: add 'hot' mark on blocks that were recently accessed (KV hits) and skip them in compaction scan. That reduces churn for large contexts where prefix blocks stay hot.

ci-bot: [alert] perf-regression: nightly/long-contexts latency +23% and OOMs increased from 0 -> 3 (jobs). Ticket created: PERF-4982

alex: I'll spin canary with miguel's params and run the long-context suite. Also will try increasing block_size to 128 and compare CPU + compaction time. Posting logs here shortly. @sara can you gate the route fallback until we have canary numbers?

sara: Yep will hold. Also add a quick metric: kernel_select.reason and workspace_required to the per-route trace so we can chart how often selection falls back.

miguel: If canary looks good, follow-up PR should include two changes:
1) adaptive workspace: allow per-model workspace_limit that scales with seq_len histogram
2) blockmgr: implement 'hot block' bitset to be ignored by compaction for N cycles

dave: Agree. Also add e2e test that simulates long-lived KV access pattern so compaction doesn't regress silently.

alex: Action items for me:
- deploy canary with params above (today)
- run long-context perf job and paste profiler+alloc snapshot (tomorrow morning)
- if green, plan rollout with monitoring for kernel_select fallback rate

miguel: I'll prototype hot-bitset on Monday; should be quick.

sara: Thanks team. Keep thread updates short. :thumbsup:

alex: Will update once canary runs finish. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
